title: Headcount: name the screener
description: Names the account that screens this treasury's Headcount reward rounds, and how long a round waits for its verdict and for council votes on held recipients. Headcount accepts this only from the treasury itself, so it takes this vote.
summary: Name {{screener_id}} as the screener of {{dao_id}}'s Headcount rounds

fields.name: dao_id
fields.label: This treasury's account
fields.help: The DAO filing this proposal, for example mydao.sputnik-dao.near. Headcount refuses any other.

fields.name: screener_id
fields.label: Screener account
fields.help: The only account that may post which recipients of this treasury's rounds are linked.

fields.name: verdict_window_sec
fields.label: Verdict window, in seconds
fields.help: How long a funded round waits for the screener's verdict before all of it can go back to the treasury. 172800 is two days.

fields.name: hold_window_sec
fields.label: Hold window, in seconds
fields.help: How long held recipients wait for a council vote before their amounts can go back to the treasury. 172800 is two days.
